rationale: The agent canceled the entire order without first authenticating the user, without confirming the order-changing action, and without attempting the user’s stated preferences (split payment, then cancel most expensive item, then switch to cheapest options). Policy requires authentication, confirmation before any write, and acting only on the user’s confirmed request. While the final message provides refund details, the lack of authentication and pre-action confirmation constitutes a clear policy violation, so the outcome fails.
